ns2:section.sectionText: Topic Title: "Doing Business in Brazil" "This is a 3rd semester language course aiming at introducing students to business/professional Portuguese in a contextualized manner through the use of a variety of texts, interviews, and work related situations. The material used offers students an opportunity to develop their use of the language in a more professional manner, taking into consideration semantic and pragmatic appropriateness in communicating in the work environment. As a language course, it places strong emphasis on the linguistic aspects of business Portuguese and provides students with the necessary language to cope well in various professional situations." TAUGHT IN PORTUGUESE.
